sql.command:
SELECT processor_id, processor_name,
       SUM(approvals) / SUM(attempts) AS approval_rate,
       MAX(p95_latency_ms) AS p95_latency_ms,
       SUM(timeout_declines) / SUM(attempts) AS timeout_decline_rate
FROM aa_payment_performance_hourly
WHERE hour_start >= (SELECT MAX(hour_start) FROM aa_payment_performance_hourly)
GROUP BY processor_id, processor_name
ORDER BY approval_rate

results.text:
"Badly" can mean several different things here, so I have not picked one for you. I can rank processors by approval rate, by p95 authorization latency, or by timeout share, and those rankings do not always agree.

Below is the most recent logical hour on all three measures so you can see which one you mean. Tell me which measure matters and I will rank on it against the seven-day baseline.
